answer: Each submission hangs on the cipher of a task receipt, and the basalt is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the ivory of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
